ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 11782, October 28, 1985>

(1) (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

(2) (Amendment to Other Statutes or Regulations)
The Enforcement Decree of the Military Personnel Management Act shall be amended as follows:

In item (b) of Article 13 (1) 2, the expression " and Commandant of the Army Comprehensive Administration School" shall be replaced with "· Commandant of the Army Comprehensive Administration School and Commandant of the Army Central Cadet Military School".
